# Devin — Style Reference

> frosted glass vitrine on a pale gallery wall, one blue pin inside. A single-weight grotesk set at 400 on #fcfcfc, hairline rules at 8% black, and a #317cff dot that lives only inside the product.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Devin speaks a vitrine-and-exhibit product language. The marketing page is a near-white display case, and the software inside it is the only thing allowed to carry color. The canvas is #fcfcfc, the footer and side rails drop to #f8f8f8, and product windows lift to #ffffff, with a translucent #0000000a wash for chat bubbles and hover fills. The chromatic budget is one system hue: #317cff, rationed to links, session dots and progress bars. A green #00a558 and red #f53b3a pair also exists, but only as diff counts and test results inside mockups. Typography runs on a single weight. NB International Pro is set at 400 from 14px to 64px and tightened to -0.03em at display sizes, so hierarchy rides on size jumps that alternate 1.25 and 1.6 rather than on bold. Actions are 9999px pills, image frames are a near-sharp 3px, and real shadows are reserved for floating product panels. The page reads as a gallery hanging the product rather than a brochure selling it.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#fcfcfc` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page background behind the hero, the logo strip and the feature grids (16 uses). It is a whisper off white, so the #ffffff product windows read as lifted without any shadow. |
| Mist Surface | `#f8f8f8` | `--color-mist-surface` | Footer slab, the outer gutters beside the 1400px rails, and recessed section bands (11 uses). It is a one-step tonal drop that marks "outside the exhibit." |
| Frosted Panel | `#ffffff` | `--color-frosted-panel` | App windows, the floating PR card, and model-picker menus (11 uses). Pure white is reserved for product surfaces, so white means "this is Devin's UI." |
| Smoke Wash | `#0000000a` | `--color-smoke-wash` | User chat bubbles, hover fills on nav pills, and sidebar selection rows (10 uses). A 4% black overlay that tints any surface without introducing a new gray. |
| Jet Action | `#000000` | `--color-jet-action` | The "Get started" fill, nav link text, and the announcement copy. Absolute black is the only CTA fill, deliberately stronger than the #191919 body ink. Do not dilute it to a gray. |
| Ink | `#191919` | `--color-ink` | Headlines, h3 feature titles, body copy in mockups, and the footer text (157 uses, the workhorse). A softened black that keeps 40px type from feeling harsh on #fcfcfc. |
| Graphite Chip | `#363636` | `--color-graphite-chip` | "View PR" buttons and dark chips inside product mockups (9 uses). It mirrors the black CTA one step lighter, so in-app actions defer to the page CTA. |
| Ash Caption | `#1919198f` | `--color-ash-caption` | Hero subcopy, feature descriptions, and the grey first line of two-tone headlines (128 uses). Ink at 56% alpha, so secondary text stays tonally tied to Ink on every surface. |
| Fog Hint | `#19191966` | `--color-fog-hint` | Step numerals such as "01", timestamps, placeholders and metadata (54 uses). Ink at 40% alpha is the quietest legible level. Do not use it for body sentences. |
| Quartz Border | `#00000014` | `--color-quartz-border` | Login pill outline, product window edges, and section hairlines (15 uses). An 8% black rule is the system's main structural device in place of boxes. |
| Signal Blue | `#317cff` | `--color-signal-blue` | The "Explore Wiki" link, unread session dots, and test-recording progress bars (25 uses across fill and text). It is the one rationed hue. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Moss Pass | `#00a558` | `--color-moss-pass` | Diff additions like "+13", "5 tests passed", and "PR Open" labels (22 uses). It is status, not brand. Keep it inside product mockups and data. |
| Ember Diff | `#f53b3a` | `--color-ember-diff` | Diff deletions like "−14" and severity markers in alert mockups (13 uses). It pairs with Moss Pass as a code-review vocabulary. Do not use it for marketing emphasis. |

## Tokens — Typography

### NB International Pro — the single-weight voice of every marketing surface · `--font-nb-international-pro`

- **Substitute:** Geist at 400, Inter Tight at 420 (variable), Hanken Grotesk at 450. NB International Pro Regular draws slightly heavier than Inter Regular at display sizes, so match up rather than down. Never drop a substitute to 300.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 14px, 16px, 20px, 32px, 40px, 64px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 64px, 1.04 at 40px, 1.2 at 32px and 20px, 1.4 at 16px and 14px
- **Letter spacing:** -1.92px at 64px, -1.2px at 40px, -0.64px at 32px, -0.2px at 20px, 0px at 16px and 14px
- **Role:** One weight from nav link to display headline is the signature. Where most AI-tool sites push h1s to 600 or 700, Devin's 40px headline at 400 is massive and quiet. The steps run 16→20→32→40→64, alternating a Major Third (1.25) with a 1.6 leap, which is steeper than a conventional single-ratio scale. Hierarchy therefore arrives in jumps instead of gradations. Negative tracking scales with size, from -0.01em at 20px to -0.03em at 40px and above, so large lines lock into dense, engineered blocks.

### Inter — the product's interface voice inside every mockup · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 and 500 (open source, use it directly with the features below), Geist at 400, IBM Plex Sans at 400. Inter here renders at its nominal weight, so no correction is needed.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px, 22px
- **Line height:** 1.333 at 12px, 1.385 at 13px, 1.429 at 14px, 1.273 at 22px
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px, -0.065px at 13px, -0.07px at 14px, -0.33px at 22px
- **OpenType features:** `cv09`, `cv10`, `ss01`, `dlig`
- **Role:** Inter is the most-used family by count (286 elements). Every one of those elements sits inside product UI, never in marketing chrome. The 13px/400 size with -0.005em tracking is the app's workhorse, and 500 and 600 appear only where the product needs bold, such as the 22px "Add enterprise SSO" title. The `ss01` and `cv09`/`cv10` alternates open the digits and straighten the terminals, so the UI reads as software. That marks a clean boundary between the page voice and the product voice. SF Pro and Lato also appear inside mockups to imitate macOS and Slack chrome. They are mockup-internal, not system tokens.

### SFMono-Regular — terminal and code labels inside the product · `--font-sf-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400, JetBrains Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400. JetBrains Mono draws a touch wider, so keep it at 12px and do not compensate with weight.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0.12px at 12px
- **Role:** The mono family appears at exactly one size, 12px with +0.01em tracking (73 uses). That is the opposite of the negative tracking on the grotesks, and it opens the characters for code legibility. It labels branches, file paths and terminal output inside mockups and is never used for marketing eyebrows. Conventional developer-tool sites stamp mono eyebrows over headlines, and Devin deliberately does not.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 400 | 12px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 400 | 13px | 1.385 | -0.065px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | NB International Pro | 400 | 14px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | NB International Pro | 400 | 16px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| subheading | NB International Pro | 400 | 20px | 1.2 | -0.2px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Inter | 600 | 22px | 1.273 | -0.33px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | NB International Pro | 400 | 32px | 1.2 | -0.64px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | NB International Pro | 400 | 40px | 1.04 | -1.2px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | NB International Pro | 400 | 64px | 1.0 | -1.92px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every NB International Pro headline at weight 400 with tracking scaled to size (-1.2px at 40px, -1.92px at 64px) — single-weight hierarchy is non-negotiable, and size plus tracking carry all rank.
- Fill the primary CTA with #000000 and outline the secondary with 1px #00000014, both at a 9999px radius — filled versus outlined replaces color-coded importance.
- Render secondary and tertiary text as #1919198f and #19191966 — alpha variants of Ink stay tonally coherent on #fcfcfc, #f8f8f8 and #ffffff alike.
- Split section headlines into a #1919198f setup line and a #191919 payoff line at 40px — value contrast does the work bold does elsewhere.
- Keep #317cff to links, session dots and progress bars, one cluster per viewport in chrome — rationed color stays a signal.
- Frame marketing imagery at 3px and product windows at 12px — the radius gap tells the reader which surface is the actual software.
- Reserve `--shadow-xl` (0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)) for one floating panel per scene — the strongest depth marks the payoff object.

### Don't

- Don't bump the 40px h2 to weight 600 or 700 to "add punch" — a bolded headline breaks the quiet single-weight voice that defines the page, and it reads as a sales banner instead of a gallery label.
- Don't fill "Get started" with #317cff because it is the brand hue — never let the accent become the action, because blue means information here and the #000000 pill means commitment.
- Don't round feature media tiles to 12px or 16px to match the product windows — the 3px frame is what separates page from exhibit.
- Don't use #00a558 or #f53b3a for marketing emphasis or icons — they are code-review data (+13 / −14), and borrowing them dilutes their meaning.
- Don't add `--shadow-md` to the 94px nav or to section bands — chrome is defined by #00000014 hairlines and tonal steps, and shadows belong to product objects.
- Don't set marketing headings in Inter 600 because it already ships in the bundle — Inter at 13px is the product's voice, and using it on the page erases the frame/exhibit boundary.
- Don't loosen display tracking to 0px at 40px or 64px — without -0.03em the single weight looks thin and undesigned rather than deliberately restrained.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fcfcfc (Paper Canvas)
- product surface: #ffffff (Frosted Panel)
- primary text: #191919 (Ink)
- secondary text: #1919198f (Ash Caption)
- border: #00000014 (Quartz Border)
- accent: #317cff (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #000000 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and progress bars use #317cff as a solid fill or at 8% opacity for tracks, and #00a558 / #f53b3a only for positive or negative deltas. All other series stay in Ink alpha steps (#191919, #1919198f, #19191966), so data never outshouts the black CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with display inline-flex, align-items center, height 40px, padding 0px 16px, background #000000, color #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, and font-family NB International Pro (fallback Geist 400) at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, letter-spacing 0px, with no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and reduce opacity to 0.9. For the nav variant use height 28px, padding 0px 12px 1px and 14px text. Place a secondary sibling 8px away with a transparent background, color #191919, a 1px solid #00000014 border and the same 9999px radius.

2. Build a Navigation Bar: a fixed header at the top, 94px tall, transparent background, no shadow, containing a 1280px centered column. The first row is a 32px announcement bar with an 8px radius, 0px 28px padding, a gray gradient backdrop and centered NB International Pro 14px weight 400 #000000 text. The second row places a 76px×20px logo left, then links "Product", "Solutions", "Resources", "Customers", "Pricing" and "Blog", each 28px tall with 1px 12px 0px padding, a 200px radius, #000000 14px text and a #0000000a fill on hover. On the right, add a "Get a demo" text link in #191919, a hairline Login pill and a black "Get started" pill, all 28px tall with 8px gaps.

3. Build a Hero Section on a #fcfcfc background: a left-aligned h1 in NB International Pro at 40px, weight 400, line-height 1.04, letter-spacing -1.2px, color #191919, max-width 568px, over two lines. Add 16px below it, then a paragraph at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, color #1919198f, max-width 455px. Add 32px, then the primary pill and a secondary hairline pill, both 40px tall. Below, after 60px, place a #ffffff app window with a 12px radius, a 1px solid #00000014 border and the shadow 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Overlap its right edge with a #ffffff card at a 12px radius, 24px padding and the shadow 0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25).

4. Build a Feature Media Tile: a container 619px wide. The top is a 3px-radius frame, 310px tall, with no border or shadow, filled with a desaturated blue-gray textured image, and a #ffffff product fragment centered inside at a 12px radius with the shadow 0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06). Add 16px below it, then an h3 in NB International Pro at 20px, weight 400, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing -0.2px, color #191919. Add 8px, then a description at 16px, line-height 1.4, color #1919198f. Lay two tiles side by side with a 4px gap.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every NB International Pro headline at weight 400 with tracking scaled to size (-1.2px at 40px, -1.92px at 64px) — single-weight hierarchy is non-negotiable, and size plus tracking carry all rank.
- Fill the primary CTA with #000000 and outline the secondary with 1px #00000014, both at a 9999px radius — filled versus outlined replaces color-coded importance.
- Render secondary and tertiary text as #1919198f and #19191966 — alpha variants of Ink stay tonally coherent on #fcfcfc, #f8f8f8 and #ffffff alike.
- Split section headlines into a #1919198f setup line and a #191919 payoff line at 40px — value contrast does the work bold does elsewhere.
- Keep #317cff to links, session dots and progress bars, one cluster per viewport in chrome — rationed color stays a signal.
- Frame marketing imagery at 3px and product windows at 12px — the radius gap tells the reader which surface is the actual software.
- Reserve `--shadow-xl` (0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)) for one floating panel per scene — the strongest depth marks the payoff object.

### Don't

- Don't bump the 40px h2 to weight 600 or 700 to "add punch" — a bolded headline breaks the quiet single-weight voice that defines the page, and it reads as a sales banner instead of a gallery label.
- Don't fill "Get started" with #317cff because it is the brand hue — never let the accent become the action, because blue means information here and the #000000 pill means commitment.
- Don't round feature media tiles to 12px or 16px to match the product windows — the 3px frame is what separates page from exhibit.
- Don't use #00a558 or #f53b3a for marketing emphasis or icons — they are code-review data (+13 / −14), and borrowing them dilutes their meaning.
- Don't add `--shadow-md` to the 94px nav or to section bands — chrome is defined by #00000014 hairlines and tonal steps, and shadows belong to product objects.
- Don't set marketing headings in Inter 600 because it already ships in the bundle — Inter at 13px is the product's voice, and using it on the page erases the frame/exhibit boundary.
- Don't loosen display tracking to 0px at 40px or 64px — without -0.03em the single weight looks thin and undesigned rather than deliberately restrained.

## Elevation

- **Floating PR card and overlapping hero panels:** `0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`
- **Product window edges and small chips:** `0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
- **Menu items and in-app buttons:** `0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`
- **Dropdowns and model-picker menus inside mockups:** `0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`
- **Secondary floating fragments in feature tiles:** `0px 13px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`

Every shadow lives inside product mockups. The marketing chrome uses only 1px #00000014 hairlines and the #fcfcfc→#f8f8f8 tonal step, so depth itself signals "this is software."

## Imagery

The site uses product screenshots, not photography of people or abstract illustration. Each render is a faithful #ffffff app window at a 12px radius, composited over painterly, desaturated backdrops: blurred sky, frosted architectural glass, cyanotype grids. Those backdrops sit inside 3px-radius frames with no border or shadow. In the hero, grayscale photo fragments collage around the app window and dissolve into blur, like pinned reference prints. Icons are 1.5px-stroke line glyphs at 12–14px, monochrome #191919 or #19191966. Color appears only as in-product data, alongside mockup-internal tokens: macOS traffic lights (#ff544e, #ffbb00, #00c926), GitHub syntax hues (#24292e, #032f62, #6f42c1, #d73a49, #005cc5), and a rainbow model-effort slider. None of these are system tokens, and #8dbee1 sky blue is decorative backdrop only. There are no orbs or glows. The narrative is an autonomous engineer's workspace documented like evidence.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1400px container with 60px gutters, giving a 1280px column bounded by visible 1px #00000014 vertical rails that run the page height. Sections stack at a 120px rhythm, separated by full-width horizontal hairlines rather than color bands. The hero is left-aligned: a 40px two-line headline, 16px #1919198f subcopy capped near 455px, and two pills, above a wide product-window collage that bleeds past the column with blurred fragments. Features alternate between a two-column grid of 619px tiles and a three-column grid of 410px tiles. Step blocks then alternate text-left/image-right. The logo row carries eight marks, and the home page has no pricing grid. The nav is fixed, transparent and 94px tall, with the logo and links left and actions right. The footer is a 360px #f8f8f8 slab. At 375px, use 40px for display and 60px section gaps. Overall density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fcfcfc (Paper Canvas)
- product surface: #ffffff (Frosted Panel)
- primary text: #191919 (Ink)
- secondary text: #1919198f (Ash Caption)
- border: #00000014 (Quartz Border)
- accent: #317cff (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #000000 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and progress bars use #317cff as a solid fill or at 8% opacity for tracks, and #00a558 / #f53b3a only for positive or negative deltas. All other series stay in Ink alpha steps (#191919, #1919198f, #19191966), so data never outshouts the black CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with display inline-flex, align-items center, height 40px, padding 0px 16px, background #000000, color #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, and font-family NB International Pro (fallback Geist 400) at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, letter-spacing 0px, with no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and reduce opacity to 0.9. For the nav variant use height 28px, padding 0px 12px 1px and 14px text. Place a secondary sibling 8px away with a transparent background, color #191919, a 1px solid #00000014 border and the same 9999px radius.

2. Build a Navigation Bar: a fixed header at the top, 94px tall, transparent background, no shadow, containing a 1280px centered column. The first row is a 32px announcement bar with an 8px radius, 0px 28px padding, a gray gradient backdrop and centered NB International Pro 14px weight 400 #000000 text. The second row places a 76px×20px logo left, then links "Product", "Solutions", "Resources", "Customers", "Pricing" and "Blog", each 28px tall with 1px 12px 0px padding, a 200px radius, #000000 14px text and a #0000000a fill on hover. On the right, add a "Get a demo" text link in #191919, a hairline Login pill and a black "Get started" pill, all 28px tall with 8px gaps.

3. Build a Hero Section on a #fcfcfc background: a left-aligned h1 in NB International Pro at 40px, weight 400, line-height 1.04, letter-spacing -1.2px, color #191919, max-width 568px, over two lines. Add 16px below it, then a paragraph at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.4, color #1919198f, max-width 455px. Add 32px, then the primary pill and a secondary hairline pill, both 40px tall. Below, after 60px, place a #ffffff app window with a 12px radius, a 1px solid #00000014 border and the shadow 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Overlap its right edge with a #ffffff card at a 12px radius, 24px padding and the shadow 0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25).

4. Build a Feature Media Tile: a container 619px wide. The top is a 3px-radius frame, 310px tall, with no border or shadow, filled with a desaturated blue-gray textured image, and a #ffffff product fragment centered inside at a 12px radius with the shadow 0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06). Add 16px below it, then an h3 in NB International Pro at 20px, weight 400, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing -0.2px, color #191919. Add 8px, then a description at 16px, line-height 1.4, color #1919198f. Lay two tiles side by side with a 4px gap.

## Single-Weight Hierarchy

The defining discipline is that NB International Pro exists at exactly one weight, 400, across six sizes from 14px to 64px. Rank comes from three levers only: size steps that alternate 1.25 and 1.6, negative tracking that deepens to -0.03em at 40px, and alpha value (#191919 against #1919198f). The system breaks the moment anyone sets a headline at 500 or bolds a keyword for emphasis, because the page stops sounding like a measured statement and starts sounding like an ad. To extend it, add a size rather than a weight. A new 48px step at -1.44px tracking and a 1.04 line height fits the scale. For emphasis inside a heading, use the two-tone split, Ash Caption setup and Ink payoff, instead of bold or color.

## Color Lives Inside

Devin's chromatic budget is one chrome hue plus a two-color status pair, and all three point inward toward the product. #317cff appears in the page chrome only as a link color. Everywhere else it marks session dots and progress inside mockups, while #00a558 and #f53b3a speak exclusively in diffs and test results. What breaks this is a colored CTA, a blue section band, gradient headings, or green checkmark bullets in marketing copy. Each one moves color from evidence to decoration. To extend the system, let new product features bring their own in-app color, such as a new status chip inside a mockup, while every new marketing component stays in #000000, Ink alphas and the #fcfcfc/#f8f8f8/#ffffff stack.

## Frame Versus Exhibit

Shape and depth encode a single distinction: page or product. Marketing frames are near-sharp at 3px with no shadow. Product windows are 12px with hairlines and real shadows. Actions are pills at 9999px, and nav links use 200px. Rounding a feature frame to 12px, adding a drop shadow to the nav, or giving a footer column a card treatment collapses the two layers, and the screenshots stop reading as real software. When adding a new section, decide first whether the element is page or product. Page elements take 3px or 0px radii, hairline separation and no shadow. Product elements take 6px–16px radii, #ffffff fills and the shadow tokens. The asymmetric 20px 4px 20px 20px chat bubble is the one licensed exception, because it imitates chat convention.

## Similar Brands

- **Linear** — A grayscale marketing shell where product screenshots carry nearly all the color. Linear runs dark, where Devin stays on #fcfcfc.
- **Vercel** — A black 9999px pill as the primary CTA with hairline secondaries and tight negative display tracking. Vercel leans on Geist at heavier weights.
- **Cursor** — A direct AI-coding competitor that also leads with a full app-window hero collage. Cursor uses heavier headlines and more saturated backdrops.
- **Factory** — An autonomous-agent category peer with restrained type and engineering-document framing. Devin softens it with painterly photographic backdrops.
- **Notion** — Single-weight editorial headlines and near-white canvases where the product UI is the illustration. Notion permits playful drawings that Devin excludes.
